name: tags-input
title: Tags input
description: Type text and press Enter or comma to add it as a removable tag.
a11y: A native text input; Enter or comma adds the tag, and leaving the field adds pending text.
Backspace in an empty field removes the last tag.
Each tag has a button named "Remove <tag>"; the field takes its name from a label or aria-label.

props.name: value
props.description: The current tags when controlled. Pair with `onValueChange`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The tags present at first when uncontrolled. Default empty.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the full list of tags after one is added or removed.

props.name: size
props.description: `md` (default), `sm` for dense layouts or `lg` for prominent forms. Heights match Button, Input and Select at each size.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the field as having an error: sets `aria-invalid` and shows the error border.

usage: import {Field, TagsInput} from '@monoline/react';
